chunks: And it was narrated from al-Ḥusayn ibn al-Mukhtār, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: "Can a man enter ihram in a black garment?" He said: "He should not enter ihram in a black garment, nor should the deceased be shrouded in it."

key_terms.يُحْرِمُ: enters the state of ihram for hajj or ʿumrah

ai.seo_question: Can a person enter ihram wearing a black garment, and may the deceased be shrouded in black?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning dress in the state of ihram and also regarding shrouding the deceased. It indicates that a black garment is not to be used for entering ihram, and likewise is not to be used as a shroud for the dead.
